recipe.visualDefinition: A clean, high-key studio photograph of a man in a brown pinstripe suit holding two large bouquets of flowers wrapped in newspapers. The subject is positioned on the left, looking toward the camera with a slight smirk, while the right side of the frame is reserved for bold, structured typography against a stark white background.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject-to-negative-space ratio favoring the right side for text
Contrast between the organic textures of flowers and the rigid stencil type
Color coordination between the red display text and warm tones in the bouquet
Diagonal upward tilt of the primary title mirroring the angle of the newspaper wraps
coreInvariants: Newspaper props featuring large, bold headlines

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject occupies the left two-thirds of the frame, scaled to show upper body and hands.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The man's face and the large newspaper headlines acting as a central focal point.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the subject's face, moves down to the newspaper headlines, then follows the diagonal title 'BUSTER' to the right-hand text block.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Extensive white space on the right side and top margins to provide breathing room for metadata.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: White (background) providing a clinical, clean canvas.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Brown and grey (suit and newspaper) providing earthy, neutral mid-tones.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Red (display type) and vibrant floral hues (purple, yellow, red) for visual pop.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High-value background with medium-saturation accents in the flowers and title.
paletteRestrictions: Limit primary text to a single bold accent color

letterConstructionRules: Display title uses a stencil-cut effect with horizontal gaps in vertical strokes
Secondary text uses a clean, grotesque sans-serif
characterSpecificRedesigns: Title characters feature rounded outer corners but sharp internal stencil cuts
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Stencil display face paired with a functional, high-legibility Swiss-style sans-serif.
graphicDevices: Diagonal baseline for the main title
Newspaper texture as a secondary typographic surface

preserve: Stencil gaps in the main title

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy, geometric stencil look of the main title.
Matches the clean, mid-century modern feel of the credit text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Photograph a man in a brown pinstripe suit holding two large bouquets of mixed flowers wrapped in newspapers with large black headlines. Use a pure white studio background with flat, even lighting. Position the man on the left side of the frame.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a large red stencil-style title in the top right, rotated 15 degrees upward. Add a column of right-aligned sans-serif text below the title in dark grey.

verificationChecks: Is the background pure white without shadows?
Is the main title in a red stencil font?
Is the credit text block flush-right?
Does the subject hold newspaper-wrapped flowers?

adjustableVariables: Type of flowers in the bouquet
Specific headlines on the newspaper props
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the stencil gaps are visible in the title.
Check that the right-hand text does not overlap the flowers.
Verify the suit texture is sharp and visible.
Confirm the white background is blown out to pure hex #FFFFFF.
recipe.reuseFormula: Subject(Left) + WhiteSpace(Right) + DiagonalStencilTitle(TopRight) + FlushRightSans(MidRight) = Retro Soundtrack Aesthetic
